notes.title: Big patch notes !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588259/b057c28c76c0d746cddb4c37a35d7e1d29c7300e.png[/img]

[b]Hi, guys!

Today is a big day!

We are rolling out a big new patch in Super Nano Blaster. Many fixes and adjustments have been made thanks to your feedback. You can check them out in the patch notes below – or directly in the game. 😊

We are extremely grateful for your incredible help. Please keep posting your impressions in the forum, they help us improve our game A LOT.[/b]

Patch notes :

[i]SHIP CONTROLS:
	- Added key to slow down. Players can bind it in the control settings panel.
	- Triggers can now be assigned on controllers

OVERCLOCK:
	- On activation, all enemy projectiles on screen will be destroyed acting as a panic button.

PERFECT SWITCH (check the scoring system guide for more informations):
	- Tweaked timing to facilitate the perfect switch.
	- Added visual feedback around the ship for a better understanding of its area of effect. 

NANO SPREADER (ship 08):
	- Increased projectiles size.
	- Fixed projectile collisions in overclock mode.

COLLECTABLES:
	- Changed shield sprite to prevent the previous confusion with lives.
	- Changed shields spawn. Shields now spawn after a certain amount of death depending on the difficulty and keep spawning until the player reaches the next checkpoint.
	- Increased the maximum amount of shields obtainable from 4 to 9 and is now displayed in the UI.
	- Shields and random ship collectables now destroy all enemy projectiles in a small area around them when they spawn to ease their collection.

INFINITE MODE:
	- Can now be played on any difficulty.
	- the first random ship spawns sooner.

SCORE ORBS:
	- Fixed collisions to be more precise and consistent.

MOVING HITZONES (level 5 & 6):
	- Removed instant death for players with shields. Projectiles will also pass through.

BOSS BALANCING:
	- The Recycler (level 02): Reduced speed in phase 3.
	- The Cargo (level 03): Reduced cargo's HP from 30 to 25 in phase 1.
	- The Void (lvl 06): Reduced HP from 500 to 400 in phase 3.[/i]

notes.title: 2 days before the release !
notes.notes:
[url=https://ibb.co/FHk8TtZ][img]https://i.ibb.co/9Zmy5jK/logo02.png[/img][/url]

[b]Hello guys ![/b]

Time is flying and there are now only 2 days before the release!
 
We are super excited about the launch but also very curious to see your feedbacks !
As we said on a previous post, we have made some small improvements on the game and we really hope you will like them !

To celebrate our joy (and because we love to make you happy), we will launch the game with a little discount : [b]7,90€ instead of 9,90€ for a limited time period following the release !
[/b]
[b]Ready to spray some bullets everywhere ?[/b]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

We are super happy to finally reveal the release date of Super Nano Blaster on Steam!
Start training your reflexes and prepare your ship: [b]Super Nano Blaster will be available on May 3rd[/b], with an exclusive release offer.

Since the Steam Fest, the game has evolved a lot thanks to the many feedbacks you gave us! 

We can already reveal one of the big news of the release: [b]the addition of a brand new ship![/b]

We will communicate the different additions we have included in the game as we go along!

Until then, stay tuned!

3.5 Inch Team
